description: This file defines the interface FilterFieldExpression, which extends FieldExpression and provides methods for accepting visitors for expression evaluation, specifically for filtering within query expressions.

classes.name: FilterFieldExpression
classes.description: An interface for filter field expressions used to create query filters based on specific fields, supporting visitor pattern methods for evaluation.

methods.name: acceptFilterVisitor
methods.description: Accepts a FilterFieldExpressionVisitor to evaluate the filter expression, returning a result of generic type T.

methods.name: <T> accept
methods.description: Overrides the accept method from FieldExpression, accepting a FieldExpressionVisitor for general expression evaluation.
